article_context: Body image 03 follows 2026 housing plans and the message that people do not want to postpone buying a home, using a landscaped family courtyard to convey comfortable everyday life now.
image_reading: A modern residential courtyard with planted flowerbeds, trees, a wooden playground, and apartment façades.
A family occupies the foreground path: an adult pushes a stroller while another adult carries a baby and a small child walks beside them.
Other children and an adult are visible near the playground; leaves and flowering plants can move naturally in a light breeze.

models.positive_prompt: The family walks slowly forward along the path, the stroller rolling smoothly beside the small child; flowers and tree leaves sway lightly. Fixed camera on the family. In the final frame they are visibly closer in the foreground, continuing their calm walk through the courtyard.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the foreground family begins moving at once in one steady, natural walk toward the camera. The stroller rolls smoothly while the child keeps pace beside it; a light breeze moves the nearby flowers and leaves. Keep the camera fixed on the path. By the last moments, the family is clearly nearer the foreground and still calmly progressing together.

models.positive_prompt: The family makes a calm, continuous walk toward the foreground, with the stroller rolling alongside the child; nearby flowers and leaves stir gently. Fixed camera. End with the family noticeably closer on the path, still moving together.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, let the family advance in a measured, uninterrupted walk from the first moment, using the stroller's rolling movement to carry the action through the full shot. Subtle wind through the planting supports the lived-in courtyard without becoming another event. Maintain a fixed view of the foreground path; the endpoint is the family arriving noticeably closer while preserving its relaxed shared movement.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera as the family walks steadily toward the foreground with the stroller, the child staying alongside; flowerbeds and leaves move softly in the breeze. The final frame shows the family clearly closer on the path, still calmly together.
models.scene_plan: In four seconds, focus on a compact, even forward walk by the foreground family. The stroller moves smoothly and the child remains beside it, while a slight breeze animates the visible greenery. Keep the camera fixed to make the approach readable. Near the end, the family has reached a visibly closer position on the path and remains together in the comfortable courtyard.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A comfortable, family-oriented home environment is something people can choose and enjoy now rather than postpone.
structured_intent.primary_action: The foreground family walks together along the courtyard path with the stroller.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The courtyard remains a calm, welcoming place for everyday family life.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The family is visibly closer in the foreground, still progressing together on the path.
